"import cadquery as cq

# Plain sleeve (annular ring) — all dimensions hard-coded, no randomness.
OD = 60.0   # outer diameter
ID = 40.0   # coaxial through bore diameter
H = 20.0    # height along Z

# Base face at z=0, centered on origin in XY: single sketch with both circles,
# one extrude — avoids coplanar boolean issues entirely.
part = (cq.Workplane("XY")
        .circle(OD / 2.0)
        .circle(ID / 2.0)
        .extrude(H))

shape = part.val()  # single Solid (outer cyl + bore + two annular end faces)

cq.exporters.export(shape, "part.step")"
